title: Adopt Factory Mode

steps.action: Resolve CURRENT.yaml once and load FACTORY_MODE_PROFILE_v1 plus only relevant Golden/process contracts.
Inspect the target repository, existing APP_FACTORY_ADOPTION.yaml and current workflow files before any write.
Run adopt_factory_mode.py without --apply and review the bounded adoption plan.
If custom workflows exist, preserve them and plan only an integration delta; never replace or overwrite them during adoption.
Apply or update only APP_FACTORY_ADOPTION.yaml with the canonical profile pointer and per-app overrides.
Run validate_factory_adoption.py and require profile/version/workflow-strategy alignment.
Add only missing Factory/AppLab integration capability as a bounded repository change; extend existing workflows when safe or add a separate workflow only when no equivalent exists.
Run the target repository's focused tests and exact-head gates after any integration delta.

completion: APP_FACTORY_ADOPTION.yaml validates against the current central profile
Factory mode is enabled without copying central process rules into the app
any workflow integration delta is independently tested and exact-head validated
